title: Zion, Bryce & the North Rim
subtitle: Juneteenth weekend, Jun 18–21, 2026, from a base camp in Kanab with Jason and Jenny: Zion, Cedar Breaks and Bryce on Friday, Pipe Spring, Glen Canyon and the Grand Canyon’s North Rim on Saturday, Lake Mead on the way home. Clock times are from the plan.

days.title: Fly to Vegas, drive to Kanab
days.html:
✈︎

OAK → LAS, then a night drive

Southwest 5051, 8:15 → 9:50 PM, four of you. Picked up the Budget economy car (Costco Travel) at Harry Reid’s rental center, then about three hours to Kanab, arriving around 1:30 AM Utah time.

All three nights at the Best Western Red Hills, 125 W Center St, Kanab, with breakfast from 6:30.

How it went: all seven planned stamps, plus Rainbow Bridge at the Carl Hayden Visitor Center, Tule Springs at the Lake Mead Visitor Center, and Wupatki, picked up separately on this trip. 10 new stamps.

days.title: Zion, Cedar Breaks, Bryce
days.sub: Kanab → Zion → Cedar Breaks → Bryce Canyon → Kanab
days.cut: Cedar Breaks sits at 10,000 ft, so bring a layer even in June.

days.title: Pipe Spring, Page, North Rim
days.sub: Kanab → Pipe Spring → Glen Canyon → North Rim → Kanab
days.tzline: Utah time; Arizona runs an hour behind in summer
days.cut: Arizona skips daylight saving time, so its clocks read an hour earlier than Kanab’s in June. Times here are the plan’s.

days.title: Lake Mead and home
days.tzline: Clocks go back an hour in Nevada
days.cut: Two stamps at one desk: Lake Mead and Tule Springs Fossil Beds, both at the Lake Mead Visitor Center.

stops.via: US-89 north, then UT-9 west through the Zion–Mount Carmel tunnel.
stops.name: Zion NP
stops.ok: Shuttle stops at Canyon Junction, Court of the Patriarchs, Zion Lodge, Big Bend and Temple of Sinawava, all flat from the stop.
stops.about: Sandstone cliffs up to 2,000 feet tall above the Virgin River, Utah’s first national park.

stops.via: Leave about 10:00. West to I-15, north to Cedar City, then UT-14.
stops.name: Cedar Breaks NM
stops.addr: Cedar Breaks National Monument Visitor Center
stops.ok: Drive-up overlooks: Point Supreme, Sunset View and Chessmen Ridge.
stops.about: A half-mile-deep amphitheater of eroded limestone on the rim of the Markagunt Plateau, above 10,000 feet.

stops.via: Leave about 12:45. UT-143 to Panguitch, then US-89 and UT-12.
stops.name: Bryce Canyon NP
stops.addr: Bryce Canyon National Park Visitor Center
stops.ok: Rim viewpoints along the main road; Bryce Point and Inspiration Point are the most dramatic.
stops.about: Not really a canyon: a series of amphitheaters packed with hoodoos, the tall spires of eroded pink and orange rock.

stops.name: Kanab, UT
stops.addr: Best Western Red Hills, 125 W Center St, Kanab, UT
stops.note: Back at the Best Western Red Hills for dinner and rest. Tomorrow starts at 7:00 AM.

stops.name: Pipe Spring NM
stops.ok: Winsor Castle, the 1870s fort over the spring, with cabins and orchards on a flat self-guided loop.
stops.about: A desert spring used for centuries by the Kaibab Paiute, later a Mormon ranch fort on the Arizona Strip.

stops.via: Leave about 8:30. Back through Kanab, then US-89 east to Page.
stops.name: Glen Canyon NRA
stops.addr: Carl Hayden Visitor Center, Page, AZ

also.name: Rainbow Bridge NM
also.where: Same desk at the Carl Hayden Visitor Center

stops.ok: Views of Glen Canyon Dam and Lake Powell; the bridge beside it looks straight down the 710-foot concrete arch.
stops.about: Lake Powell and the red-rock canyons around it, backed up behind Glen Canyon Dam since 1963.

stops.via: Leave about 10:45. US-89 south, US-89A across Navajo Bridge, then AZ-67 at Jacob Lake.
stops.name: Grand Canyon NP
stops.addr: North Rim Visitor Center, Grand Canyon
stops.ok: Bright Angel Point is an easy walk to a huge overlook, with far fewer people than the South Rim.
stops.about: A mile deep and up to 18 miles wide. The North Rim sits about 1,000 feet higher than the South Rim and closes in winter.

stops.via: Leave about 3:30. AZ-67 north, US-89A through Fredonia.
stops.name: Kanab, UT
stops.addr: Best Western Red Hills, 125 W Center St, Kanab, UT
stops.note: Last night at the Best Western Red Hills. Tomorrow: check out at 8:00 for the drive to Boulder City.

stops.tz: Clocks go back an hour in Nevada
stops.via: Checked out at 8:00 Utah time (7:00 in Nevada). West through Colorado City and Hurricane to I-15, then south past Las Vegas to Boulder City.
stops.name: Lake Mead NRA
stops.place: Lake Mead Visitor Center, Boulder City
stops.addr: Lake Mead Visitor Center, 601 Nevada Way, Boulder City, NV
stops.where: Lake Mead Visitor Center, 601 Nevada Way

also.name: Tule Springs Fossil Beds NM
also.where: Same desk at the Lake Mead Visitor Center

stops.about: The country’s first national recreation area, around the reservoirs behind Hoover and Davis dams.

stops.title: Las Vegas → home
stops.note: Returned the car at Harry Reid, then Southwest 2334, 3:50 → 5:30 PM to Oakland. 10 new stamps for the weekend.
